scope: Explicit grouped source-topic decisions; exact age contexts reviewed.

readLogs.notes: Read the guidance on individual pace, observation, child control, suitable materials, frustration, and parent role.
Read the movement context and the encouragement to wait for self-initiated sitting.

Read the 6–9-month observation unit and the heading/framing for 9–12 months.
Read self-initiated cruising and the complete push-wagon introduction.
Read supervised stairs, help learning descent and individual walking timing.

Read taking puzzle pieces out, drawers, and the 9–12-month observation unit.
Read the observation continuation and adapting support to the individual baby.
Read the monthly care, movement and wagon context with its shorter pull-up wording.

Stable-sitting and prior-skill ring rows; spinning top, drawer boxes, push balls and attached furniture key.
Cabinet/drawer, basket-ring, napkin-ring and graded-ring rows with separate age labels.
12+ peg/cube/opening rows and separate around-13+ locks and slotted-box rows.
Numbered photographs connect the coin-slot box and other hand activities to their captions.
Full caption page confirms the photograph-specific posting and opening/closing ages.
Full table preserves separate 12+ material rows and around-13+ strongly attached key row.
Full table preserves the distinct horizontal, serpentine and colored-ring age rows.
